_notes._doc: Ruby's gTileset_Cave as the secondary tileset of an OUTDOOR map: only Route 130 (both of its layouts) uses it so. These five are the secondary metatiles of Mirage Island (LAYOUT_UNREFERENCED_MAP, Route 130's layout while the island is there; postgame_maps 2026-10-07). Caves never go through these labels (their builder reads data/cave_tiles.json).
